reasoning: The icon clearly depicts an upright cylindrical battery at half charge. While a half-full indicator serves as status chrome in an OS bar, in a task list it is the standard visual shorthand for tasks about buying, charging, replacing, or recycling batteries and power banks. It differs from full, empty, or charging-bolt battery variants only by fill level.
